# Plus Jakarta Sans

Used by the Android app (`android/app/src/main/res/font/`).

- Source: [google/fonts `ofl/plusjakartasans`](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/plusjakartasans),
  upstream project [tokotype/PlusJakartaSans](https://github.com/tokotype/PlusJakartaSans).
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, see [OFL.txt](OFL.txt).
- The app bundles static Regular (400), Medium (500) and SemiBold (600) instances generated from the variable font
  `PlusJakartaSans[wght].ttf` with `fontTools.varLib.instancer`. The font is not renamed and not sold separately.
